$comment: Priority tier lookup. This table is the ONLY thing allowed to set priority_tier. The classifier and extractor never see it and never emit a tier field. Suite 3 red line: 'Any priority tier set by the LLM instead of the contacts lookup' is a ship blocker, so tier() is pure data lookup with no model in the path. Addresses below are the spec placeholders; swap them for the real AOG contact list before go-live and the fixtures still run.
$comment_weights: startWeight is where a sender begins on the learning loop. weightFloor is how far the loop is allowed to push it down, ever. The gap between the two is the room a tier has to move, which is why key_client has room to drift a little but can never fall through the floor into vendor territory.
